issues.title: R01 P0 Authenticate principals and delegated authority
issues.body: Bind buyer, provider, verifier and resolver actions to authenticated principals. Acceptance criteria: signatures or authenticated sessions bind the complete request and intended audience; delegation carries scope, expiry and spending limits; replay, revocation, role confusion and unauthorised bond use fail explicit adversarial tests. Preserve local fixtures as a separate trusted-caller mode. Dependencies: none.

issues.title: R02 P0 Introduce versioned source acceptance profiles
issues.body: Replace the requirement to know an exact output digest with a pluggable, bounded acceptance interface. Acceptance criteria: pin source manifests and profile versions; reproduce structural, arithmetic and source-location checks; expose unresolved semantic questions; reject unsupported profiles; keep arbitrary submitted code outside the process. Demonstrate good, defective and indeterminate outputs against a labelled holdout corpus. Dependencies: none for local work; R01 for external submissions.

issues.title: R03 P0 Minimise and sign portable evidence
issues.body: The demonstration bundle includes the full synthetic ledger. Acceptance criteria: export only authorised contract evidence; exclude unrelated transactions and unnecessary personal data; define canonical bytes and signed statements; verify signers and key status; obtain a checkpoint through an independently trusted channel. Tests must expose altered, omitted, reordered and substituted records. Document remaining completeness and collusion limits. Dependencies: R01, R02.

issues.title: R04 P0 Design transactional production persistence
issues.body: Extend the existing SQLite transaction model to a documented multi-process architecture. Acceptance criteria: preserve balanced postings, non-negative permitted balances, immutable terms, payload-bound idempotency and at-most-once economic effects under races and crash recovery; use an outbox and reconciliation strategy for external effects; exercise migration and restore. Model-check a bounded lifecycle if a formal specification is added, and report its assumptions. Dependencies: none for architecture; R01 for service boundaries.

issues.title: R05 P1 Implement one protocol adapter with conformance
issues.body: Select A2A or MCP from the first pilot's actual integration need. Acceptance criteria: pin one protocol and SDK release; test request, error, cancellation and retry semantics against official fixtures or an independent implementation; preserve authority and acceptance boundaries; document unsupported features. Keep payment adapters separate. Dependencies: R01, R02, R04.

issues.title: R06 P1 Run the commercial benchmark
issues.body: Recruit one defined B2B extraction segment and compare the workflow with its existing review process. Acceptance criteria: authorised representative samples, labelled defects, published denominators, review-time measurements, itemised support cost and recorded buyer feedback; distinguish internal tests from independent users and paid demand. Apply the commercial plan's chosen gates without presenting them as forecasts. Dependencies: R02; discovery interviews can begin independently.

issues.title: R07 P0 Establish payment and legal readiness
issues.body: Keep live payment paths disabled while evaluating an actual operating model. Acceptance criteria: identify contracting parties, authority, custody and release powers; confirm applicable obligations with qualified advisers and the proposed provider; agree fees, refunds, disputes and data responsibilities; test reconciliation and provider failures in provider test mode. A documented launch decision must specify exposure limits. No simulated balance counts as customer funds. Dependencies: R01, R03, R04, R06.

issues.title: R08 P1 Add observability and recovery procedures
issues.body: Acceptance criteria: structured operational events, measured transition latency, verification outcomes, replay conflicts and reconciliation exceptions; redact sensitive fields; define alert ownership, incident response, backup restore and reconciliation halt conditions. Test the response to injected failures. Separate service telemetry from independently verified historical evidence. Dependencies: R04; pilot instrumentation also supports R06.

issues.title: R09 P1 Publish an implementation and conformance matrix
issues.body: Acceptance criteria: map each specification requirement to code and a meaningful test; identify fixture-only behaviour, unsupported integrations and production gaps; make installation and examples reproducible in clean CI; document release provenance and supported versions. A release must not imply completed legal, security or protocol certification. Dependencies: existing sandbox now; update with R01–R08 as implemented.
